observation.evidence_text:
June 2025: 599472 eligible flights; frozen-model ROC-AUC 0.670556; log loss 0.581635 versus training-prior baseline 0.616520; Brier score 0.197419 versus baseline 0.210070.
Descriptive uncertainty: 1000 seeded resamples of 30 complete flight-date clusters; model-minus-prior 95% percentile intervals are [-0.044405, -0.026045] for mean log loss and [-0.016123, -0.009439] for mean Brier score; negative differences favour the model.
This frozen later-month US comparison does not establish a globally untouched holdout, statistical significance, causality, UAE validation or operational approval. No refit, threshold change, new inference or deployment is performed by this tool.
The fixed decision threshold is 0.17; report fingerprint 1928b626dfe131611bd3668bdd48e8baeaf022b0bf8919c364a682ec0298c372. The monthly SQL selector and January-May prediction window are unchanged.
